title: Glovebox at a glance
subtitle: What the code does today: an agent with a token filters, sorts, groups and counts fictional fixture mail as handles and typed fields, never as text

nodes.label: AI agent
nodes.sub: MCP client with a bearer token

nodes.label: Glovebox
nodes.sub: typed fields, validated judgments; no text

evidence.note: Only an MCP client in the acceptance tests connects today; no real agent integration is in the code, so this node is inferred.

The read tools list_accounts, list_items, count_items, group_items and list_topics return permitted fields only, for the accounts the token covers, including four semantic fields a quarantined classifier proposes and the gate validates. get_availability, list_events and list_overlaps answer busy and free windows, upcoming events and overlaps of calendar accounts as handles, times and a busy status, with no semantic fields.

Fixture sources: a file or a stand-in, for mail (the mailbox.org mail stand-in), for messenger conversations (the bridge stand-ins) or for calendar events (the calendar stand-ins, read by calendars.py); and the iMessage source, which also reads the Mac's Messages database read-only (no real Mac has been tried yet).
The client reaches the service at /mcp over Streamable HTTP with a bearer token the operator issued and can revoke.
